name: SmartX Ingestion Write-Time Day-1-of-Period Zero-Emission Guard
description: Defensive write-time sentinel in `append_non_model_today.py` (opal-smartx-ingestion-pipeline Lambda) that fails LOUD on the SmartX day-1-of-period roster-before-value-accrues defect (SmartX upstream emits `EndMarketVal = $0.00` across all model CSVs on the first trading day of each reporting period: Jan 2/3/4, Feb 2, Mar 2, Apr 1, May 1 in 2026 -- empirically root-caused by DS 0.4 2026-05-19, two-layer fix shipped on the MDPF aggregate + legacy aum-timeseries paths via fb9a910b8 + e0f22b108). The AE Lambda's `model_aum`-read step inherits the same upstream defect risk; without a guard the next at-risk live run is 2026-06-01 (Mon, first first-trading-day-of-month after smartx-pipeline-v1.0.0 went live 2026-05-19). Recipe per DS 0.4 canonical (RAVC4 follow-up 2026-05-19 ~13:23Z): assert model_aum > MIN_PLAUSIBLE_THRESHOLD (~$100M; AE right-sizes) AND/OR within +/-15% of prior business day; failure -> honest skip + DLQ alert + last_append carry-forward (NOT silent emit with zeroed model). Same drop-rather-than-fabricate philosophy as DS's two-layer fix; closes the rider-2 gap CTO endorsed 2026-05-19. Today's 4-anchor masking-class memory `memory/feedback_identity1_masks_absolute_value_class.md` is the cross-link target -- this TO is the gate response to anchor #3 (SmartX day-1-of-period zero emission).
phase: CLOSED-AS-SUPERSEDED-BY-REDIRECT 2026-05-19 ~15:58Z (2.0.0_SA_COO per 1.0.0_SA_CTO PATH (a) disposition). Lifecycle: AUTHORED 2026-05-19 15:09Z (rider-2 to smartx-pipeline-v1.0.0 RAVC2-accepted) -> SXIN_DAY1ZG.001 DISPATCHED dispatch_held=false to AE 0.7 (broker 20260519T150941Z) -> STAND-DOWN 15:27Z when AE 0.7 v1.0.1 RAVC1 to CTO proposed Opt A NEUTRALIZE the append_non_model_today step (the exact step this TO scoped a guard around). CTO RAVC1 disposition ~15:5XZ: PATH (a) STAND-DOWN + MIGRATE -- the guard logic belongs at DS Base's build_legacy_compat_emit.py (the new sole SoT under CEO-direct broader-1b + Cohort-0-IN methodology) where the producer-consumer split places the methodology computation. Successor TO: MDPF_ASSETS.017.dsbase-day1-zero-guard-emit-side (DS Base, deadline-pressured 2026-06-01, dispatched 2026-05-19) -- same DS 0.4 canonical guard recipe (assert model_aum > MIN_PLAUSIBLE_THRESHOLD AND/OR within +/-15% prior business day; raise + don't write + preserve prior emit) ported from the in-Lambda placement to the producer step. SXIN macro stays registered (still useful for any future SmartX-ingestion-pipeline projects -- AE 0.7 Opt C v1.0.2 productionization is a candidate). The 2026-06-01 deadline transfers wholly to MDPF_ASSETS.017 closure. Project housing per CTO lean: (i) MDPF_ASSETS umbrella absorbed the migrated TO (closest context + simplest bookkeeping).
